description: 读取微博热搜榜(排名/热词/热度值/分类/标签/链接)。先落到 weibo.com 域,再在页面内同源 fetch JSON——带上登录 cookie、不被风控挡(直接 navigate 到 ajax 接口会被喂 SPA HTML)。

steps.fn: async () => { const limit = Number('{{limit|js}}') || 30; const r = await fetch('/ajax/statuses/hot_band', { credentials: 'include' }); const t = await r.text(); let d; try { d = JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { throw new Error('微博返回非 JSON(未登录或被风控),请在持久浏览器登录 weibo.com 后重试'); } if (!d || !d.ok) throw new Error('微博热搜接口返回异常(可能未登录),请在持久浏览器登录 weibo.com 后重试'); const list = (d.data && d.data.band_list) ? d.data.band_list : []; return list.slice(0, limit).map((b, i) => ({ rank: b.realpos || (i + 1), word: b.word, hot: b.num || 0, category: b.category || '', label: b.label_name || '', url: 'https://s.weibo.com/weibo?q=' + encodeURIComponent('#' + b.word + '#') })); }
